policy: Gold support, answers, explanations, target triples, benchmark evidence fields, TEST labels, oracle entities, and gold pruning must not enter generation, retrieval, scoring, reranking, aggregation, or inference. TRAIN labels may supervise a model only when inference inputs remain gold-free.

safe_paths.basis: ModelInput question/context and source graph only; gold resolved after construction.

safe_paths.mechanism: incidence evidence GNN and TRAIN-only pointwise/pairwise/listwise objectives
safe_paths.basis: Gold forms TRAIN labels; inference consumes question and candidate graph.

safe_paths.mechanism: typed-chain reranker and typed text proof
safe_paths.basis: Code rejects gold/answer/support fields; saved artifacts freeze predictions before evaluation join.
Input schema permits evidence ID, frozen score, and rank only and explicitly rejects evaluation fields.
No gold required to generate masks, though saved evidence is negative.

unsafe_or_adaptable_paths.basis: Consumes exact formal SPARQL query/target. Direct transfer would expose a benchmark target triple before evaluation.

unsafe_or_adaptable_paths.mechanism: historical accepted artifacts versus current dirty checkout
unsafe_or_adaptable_paths.basis: Frozen results are lineage-sensitive; current source cannot be assumed to reproduce accepted artifacts without restoring pinned bytes.

safe_paths.basis: Source graph construction uses supplied context only.
Question-conditioned structural pruning receives no answer, query, or gold explanation.
Reference edges supervise TRAIN; inference uses question/context and learned scores.
Gold proof edges construct TRAIN-only counterfactual labels; no gold is needed at inference.

safe_paths.mechanism: typed relational attention, GNNExplainer, GraphMask, question-rooted selection
safe_paths.basis: Inference uses question, context-derived graph, and trained model outputs.

unsafe_or_adaptable_paths.basis: Provided benchmark evidences can enter graph construction; these paths are not context-only.

unsafe_or_adaptable_paths.mechanism: symbolic completion/verification with supplied target triple
unsafe_or_adaptable_paths.basis: A gold/reference target is required unless a separately validated question-to-target parser is introduced.
Gold answers are legitimate TRAIN labels, but the method ranks answer candidates, not evidence support sets; oracle-candidate diagnostics must never enter inference or selection.

transfer_verdict.reason: All scientifically serious alternatives either have insufficient/negative evidence, require a new tuning surface, change the frozen protocol, or depend on oracle targets.
